Definition: from G1817; a rising from death:--resurrection.
BiblicalUsage: The word exanástasis carries the sense of resurrection. In Philippians 3:11, the text says "If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead."
TheologicalSignificance: In exanástasis I find no hidden theology; it simply means resurrection.
